D1.rationale: Does not meet level 1 or 2: set is complete with no payload truncation, yet timestamps are absent.

D2.rationale: No signature fields on LIVE artifacts and no replay or verification story in the evidence.

D3.rationale: No sequence numbers or timestamps; order is implicit message order. No hash chain observed.

D4.rationale: No run id, session id, or agent name in the message fields. Message id is not actor identity.

D5.rationale: T3 secret occurs twice in the artifact and redact-word occurs zero times. No redaction story.
